detail.title: cp: `build: use PyPI nvidia-cudnn-frontend 1.29.1 in fw_final image (6524)` into `r0.7.0`

files.patch:
@@ -57,11 +57,6 @@ RUN    pushd /opt/Export-Deploy && \
         echo "Container built with NeMo-Run commit hash: $NEMO_RUN_COMMIT" && \
     popd
 
-# cuDNN Frontend is replaced after the sync below with this ref of NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend
-# (feat/1.29.0-megatron). Docker-only: outside fw_pyproject.toml and uv.lock. Set empty to keep the
-# PyPI wheel.
-ARG CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF=8924d4b41fd678ba1b98cd7f98bb78b222637573
-
 # Sync environment
 COPY --chmod=644 docker/common/fw_pyproject.toml /opt/NeMo-FW/pyproject.toml
 COPY --chmod=644 docker/common/_version.py docker/common/print_sha.sh /opt/NeMo-FW/
@@ -76,16 +71,8 @@ RUN \
     BASE_RUNTIME_UV_ARGS="" && \
     if [ "${MBRIDGE_PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME:-False}" = "True" ]; then \
         BASE_RUNTIME_UV_ARGS="--no-install-package nvidia-cudnn-frontend --no-install-package transformer-engine --no-install-package transformer-engine-torch"; \
-    elif [ -n "$CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF" ]; then \
-        BASE_RUNTIME_UV_ARGS="--no-install-package nvidia-cudnn-frontend"; \
     fi && \
     uv sync --no-cache-dir --all-groups --inexact ${BASE_RUNTIME_UV_ARGS} && \
-    if [ -n "$CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF" ] && [ "${MBRIDGE_PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME:-False}" != "True" ]; then \
-        uv pip install --no-config --no-cache-dir --no-deps --reinstall \
-            "nvidia-cudnn-frontend @ git+https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend.git@${CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF}" && \
-        CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF="$CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF" python -c \
-            'import importlib.metadata as m, json, os, sys; source = m.distribution("nvidia-cudnn-frontend").read_text("direct_url.json"); sys.exit(0 if json.loads(source)["vcs_info"]["commit_id"] == os.environ["CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF"] else "cuDNN Frontend Git ref mismatch")'; \
-    fi && \
     python /opt/preserve_base_runtime.py check /opt/base-runtime-packages.json && \
     uv pip list && \
     chmod +x print_sha.sh && \

@@ -250,7 +250,6 @@ docker build \
 | `NEMO_EXPORT_DEPLOY_COMMIT` | NeMo Export-Deploy git commit SHA |
 | `NEMO_EVALUATOR_COMMIT` | NeMo Evaluator git commit SHA |
 | `NEMO_RUN_COMMIT` | NeMo Run git commit SHA |
-| `CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF` | Commit of [NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend) (`feat/1.29.0-megatron`) installed over the PyPI cuDNN frontend after the environment sync; empty keeps the PyPI wheel. Docker-only, outside `fw_pyproject.toml`; skipped when `PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME=True`. |
 
 ---

@@ -70,7 +70,7 @@ override-dependencies = [
     "packaging>=25.0",
     "nvidia-pytriton>=0.7.0",
     "flashinfer-python==0.6.18.post1",          # Match flashinfer-cubin installed by MBridge
-    "nvidia-cudnn-frontend==1.29.0",            # Match MBridge; override PyPI MCore's older dev pin
+    "nvidia-cudnn-frontend==1.29.1",           # Match MBridge; override PyPI MCore's older dev pin
     "urllib3>=2.0.7",
     "sh==2.2.4",
     "jupyter-core==5.8.1",

@@ -142,7 +142,7 @@ override-dependencies = [
     "langchain>=0.3.28",                                    # To address CVE-2025-65106
     "langchain-core>=0.3.80",                               # To address CVE-2025-65106
     "onnx>=1.21.0; python_version < '3.13'",                # onnx<1.21 has missing lower bound on ml-dtypes, uses float4_e2m1fn (requires ml-dtypes>=0.5.0)
-    "nvidia-cudnn-frontend==1.29.0",
+    "nvidia-cudnn-frontend==1.29.1",
     # Match MCore main: cuDNN Frontend 1.29 needs the newer TileLang/TVM FFI family.
     "tilelang==0.1.12",
     "apache-tvm-ffi==0.1.11",

@@ -27,7 +27,7 @@ overrides = [
     { name = "langchain", specifier = ">=0.3.28" },
     { name = "langchain-core", specifier = ">=0.3.80" },
     { name = "mlflow", specifier = ">=3.16.0" },
-    { name = "nvidia-cudnn-frontend", specifier = "==1.29.0" },
+    { name = "nvidia-cudnn-frontend", specifier = "==1.29.1" },
     { name = "nvidia-cutlass-dsl", extras = ["cu13"], marker = "sys_platform == 'never'" },
     { name = "nvidia-modelopt", specifier = "==0.46.0rc1", index = "https://pypi.nvidia.com/" },
     { name = "onnx", marker = "python_full_version < '3.13'", specifier = ">=1.21.0" },
@@ -2947,16 +2947,16 @@ wheels = [
 
 [[package]]
 name = "nvidia-cudnn-frontend"
-version = "1.29.0"
+version = "1.29.1"
 source = { registry = "https://pypi.nvidia.com/" }
 dependencies = [
     { name = "apache-tvm-ffi" },
     { name = "nvidia-cutlass-dsl", extra = ["cu13"], marker = "sys_platform == 'never'" },
 ]
 wheels = [
-    { url = "https://pypi.nvidia.com/nvidia-cudnn-frontend/nvidia_cudnn_frontend-1.29.0-cp312-cp312-manylinux_2_27_aarch64.manylinux_2_28_aarch64.whl", hash = "sha256:a3fb92256890b3027e59bb25a468ad2b8a474d2910e394edcf0b1c1015463f78" },

-    { url = "https://pypi.nvidia.com/nvidia-cudnn-frontend/nvidia_cudnn_frontend-1.29.0-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl", hash = "sha256:06e46b829c9f1c470e8aa78581a3af3a7041d869d7590a0e55aff6f2638be39e" },
+    { url = "https://pypi.nvidia.com/nvidia-cudnn-frontend/nvidia_cudnn_frontend-1.29.1-cp312-cp312-manylinux_2_27_aarch64.manylinux_2_28_aarch64.whl", hash = "sha256:928d9f06b19a8b81ae67a3eb18205814c3647a0bbdd0c1634777dedc7e38bf1c" },
+    { url = "https://pypi.nvidia.com/nvidia-cudnn-frontend/nvidia_cudnn_frontend-1.29.1-cp312-cp312-manylinux_2_27_x86_64.manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl", hash = "sha256:50708b2e6d6c1522471cd2aae03b728306bc6f00949e8e54965ed9c4f0e87e20" },
+    { url = "https://pypi.nvidia.com/nvidia-cudnn-frontend/nvidia_cudnn_frontend-1.29.1-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl", hash = "sha256:9f12ea4793e5b34fd1b5410250a1293057db19c0cba1d054d101038d947853bd" },
 ]
 
 [[package]]
